applicabilityBasis.summary: FRNT is a transferable USD-par stable token with a statutory reserve-backed redemption obligation. The reserve rules expressly deny legal-tender, general state-obligation and federal-insurance status; state issuance alone does not establish a national-currency exclusion.

genius.notes: Wyoming Stable Token Act issuance authority and current administrative reserve/redemption rules are verified. Commission issuance and the special trust-limited obligation do not establish a GENIUS state-qualified PPSI approval. The public review found no token-specific GENIUS approval, official application or announced GENIUS route. Redemption ordinarily runs through Licensed Service Providers at USD 1; holder access to direct Commission redemption is conditional. Daily financial examination is announced, but no current signed assurance report was retrieved; LedgerLens metrics are supplemental and non-assured. Monthly attestation presence is not asserted. No public GENIUS enforcement action was located in the reviewed sources.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or issuer-announced GENIUS route was located for Wyoming Stable Token Commission/FRNT as of 2026-10-07. Wyoming statutory issuance is not an issuer approval under GENIUS. This is a bounded public-source finding, not proof that no nonpublic filing exists.
